headline: The private demo can record learning posture without becoming surveillance.
copy: The ledger keeps event names small and makes every record local, exportable, and deletable in the future product contract.
boundary: Ledger rows are prototype records only; production requires explicit accounts, consent, export, delete, retention, and security review.

risks: Allowed only after the demo boundary is shown.
Store only question label and source packet id, not sensitive personal story.
No-source outcomes can be counted without storing private claim text.
Feedback needs export/delete language before broader pilot.
No personal reflections should be stored in demo telemetry.
No sync until identity, consent, export, delete, and retention exist.

rules.title: Consent before event
rules.copy: The demo boundary must be visible before any event is recorded.

rules.title: Minimal event names
rules.copy: Store posture, not private spiritual or emotional content.

rules.title: Export and delete next
rules.copy: The next real pilot needs user-visible control over every record.
